text:
Ryan O'Reilly is 35 and a Predator for 267 games now, and his name has joined the Minnesota rumor mill too: NHLTradeRumor.com listed him with Pavel Zacha and Evgeni Malkin as centers the Wild were eyeing after missing on Dylan Larkin. He also gave Nashville a scare last week, leaving practice early (Sports Illustrated covered coach Andrew Brunette's concern), then played the next game anyway.

On the ice he is having the kind of season that makes him worth asking about. He has 24 points in 25 games, and he ranks 36th of 568 skaters in our wins added, helped by timely goals. Evolving-Hockey had him 79th of 401 forwards last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 93rd percentile in primary shot assists.

Be careful with the goals, though. He is shooting 20.9%, above even the top of his likely range, and his own chance creation is slightly down from last season. The Predators also get only about 45% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice. The playmaking is real; the scoring touch is running hot.
